CallerIdHeader.name: x-oos-caller-id
CallerIdHeader.description: Broker caller identity. In local devint proof, source this from the broker pod's CALLER_ALLOWED_IDS.

CallerSecretHeader.name: x-oos-caller-secret
CallerSecretHeader.description: Shared caller secret. In local devint proof, source this from the broker pod's CALLER_AUTH_SHARED_SECRET.

IdeaIdParam.name: idea_id
IdeaIdParam.description: Broker-shaped idea identity such as idea-40.

DeliveryIdParam.name: delivery_id
DeliveryIdParam.description: Broker-shaped delivery identity such as delivery-38.

WorkItemIdParam.name: work_item_id
WorkItemIdParam.description: Broker-shaped delivery work item identity such as work-item-177.

IncludeDoneParam.name: include_done
IncludeDoneParam.description: Include done items in the projection.

IncludeParkedParam.name: include_parked
IncludeParkedParam.description: Include parked items in the projection.

IncludeInactiveParam.name: include_inactive
IncludeInactiveParam.description: Include parked, retired, or otherwise inactive items in the projection.

TargetPiParam.name: target_pi
TargetPiParam.description: Optional PI filter such as PI-2026-02.
